wiki.title: Mary Beth Carozza
wiki.extract: Mary Beth Carozza (born February 13, 1961) is an American politician who is a Republican member of the Maryland Senate, representing District 38 since 2019. She previous represented District 38C in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2015 to 2019.
